up: List all distinct compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5727936. For each compound, provide the compound's ChEMBL identifier (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (from molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and the canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Connect documents to compounds via the compound_records table by matching docs.doc_id = compound_records.doc_id, then join compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno, and left join compound_structures for SMILES. Filter docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727936'. Remove duplicate compounds.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727936';
